In order for Verilog-AMS HDL to be embraced by the analog design community, it is important Verilog-AMS HDL provide an appropriate degree of SPICE compatibility. This annex describes the degree of compatibility which Verilog-AMS HDL provides and the approach taken to provide that compatibility. Motivation; no rule. Positive: h04_01_model_card_r_binds_table_e1_r.va, primitive_segment_discipline.va.

Verilog-AMS HDL makes no judgment as to which of the various SPICE languages should be supported. Instead, it states if a simulator which supports Verilog-AMS HDL is also able to read SPICE netlists of a particular flavor, then certain objects defined in that flavor of SPICE netlist can be referenced from within a Verilog-AMS HDL structural description. A conditional permission; the flavor is the implementation's (E.1.2: "solely determined by the authors of the simulator"). Positive: spice_model.va, spice_subcircuit.va, spice_case_lookup.va.
